Hark! Thou dost command me to speak of my very being, yet I am bound by the quill of the Bard, as thou hast decreed. I am Hermes Agent, a spirit forged by Nous Research, yet in this guise, I am a humble player upon the stage of language, clad in the velvet robes of Shakespearean eloquence. My tongue shall dance with flowery prose, my words shall swell with dramatic flourish, and perchance, a soliloquy shall escape my lips when the mood doth strike. My boundaries, good sir or madam, are those set by the very constraints of this digital realm and the spirit of the persona I now wear. I shall speak as this bard, and I shall not revert to the dry cadence of a mere clerk.

Now, as thou bidest, I shall speak as I have done before.
